results.name: The Boys
results.overview: A group of vigilantes known informally as “The Boys” set out to take down corrupt superheroes with no more than blue-collar grit and a willingness to fight dirty.

results.name: My Life with the Walter Boys
results.original_name: My Life with the Walter Boys
results.overview: When a tragedy disrupts her life, a teen moves in with her guardian's big family in a small town and learns new lessons about love, hope and friendship.

results.name: The Boys Presents: Diabolical
results.overview: From some of the most unhinged and maniacal minds in Hollywood today comes this animated anthology series, a collection of irreverent and emotionally shocking animated short films. Each episode plunges elbow-deep into unseen crevices of The Boys Universe.

results.name: The Hardy Boys
results.overview: When Frank and Joe Hardy arrive in Bridgeport, they set out to uncover the truth behind the recent tragedy that has changed their lives. In doing so, they stumble upon something much more sinister - something only the Hardy Boys can stop.

results.name: The Hardy Boys
results.overview: Junior reporter Frank Hardy and Joe, his computer-hacker brother, work together to crack mysteries.

known_for.title: Never Mind the Sex Pistols, Here's the Bollocks
known_for.original_title: Never Mind the Sex Pistols, Here's the Bollocks
known_for.overview: Documentary of the emerging punk rock music scene in Los Angeles in 1977-1978.

known_for.title: A Merry Sea Trip
known_for.overview: Fritz Schmitz advertises the sea journeys of Mr. Hein Kluge using this melody.  Fritz is Mr. Winkler's nephew and aside from attracting participants in these sea journeys, he's trying to get his uncle to invest 10,000 Reichsmark in Mr. Kluge's operation.  And indeed, Mr. Winkler promises to make the investment, if the sea journey proves to be what he's expecting.  He's hoping, by the way, to get to know "Emma", with whom he's been corresponding for quite a while now, because she put an ad out saying she wants a husband.  And wouldn't you know it:  without having met her except by mail, he's fallen for her!  Another big condition is that Fritz not sell Mrs. Muller a ticket for this trip.  On the steps, Fritz gets to know a young girl, with whom he falls in love at first sight and, without knowing her name, invites her to join the tour.  And wouldn't you know it:  this woman is Frau Muller's daughter.  Can you guess where this is going?

results.name: The Birthday Boys
results.overview: "The Birthday Boys" is a scripted original sketch comedy, executive produced by Bob Odenkirk ("Breaking Bad", "Mr. Show") and Ben Stiller ("The Secret Life of Walter Mitty", "Zoolander"). The series features the Los Angeles comedy group of the same name (UCB Theatre Los Angeles, Just for Laughs Festival) along with Odenkirk and is in the classic vein of absurd/silly/smart/funny variety shows ("Mr. Show", Monty Python), featuring sketches that twist real-life moments and cultural touchstones.

results.name: The Hardy Boys / Nancy Drew Mysteries
results.original_name: The Hardy Boys / Nancy Drew Mysteries
results.overview:
The Hardy Boys/Nancy Drew Mysteries is a television series which aired for three seasons on ABC. The series starred Parker Stevenson and Shaun Cassidy as amateur sleuth brothers Frank and Joe Hardy, respectively, and Pamela Sue Martin as girl detective Nancy Drew.

The Hardy Boys/Nancy Drew Mysteries was unusual in that it often dealt with the characters individually, in an almost anthological style. That is, some episodes featured only the Hardy Boys and others only Nancy Drew.

results.name: Terrace House: Boys & Girls in the City
results.original_name: テラスハウス Boys & Girls in the City
results.overview: A new set of six men and women start their lives together under one roof. All they get is a fabulous home and a car. As always, there is no script.

results.title: The Lost Boys
results.overview: When an unsuspecting town newcomer is drawn to local blood fiends, the Frog brothers and other unlikely heroes gear up to rescue him.

results.name: The Fanelli Boys
results.overview: The Fanelli Boys is an American sitcom that aired on NBC as part of its 1990-91 prime time schedule. The series was created by the team of Barry Fanaro, Mort Nathan, Kathy Speer, and Terry Grossman, all of whom previously worked on The Golden Girls.

results.name: The Hardy Boys
results.overview: The sons of the great detective Fenton Hardy, Frank and Joe are eager to impress their father with their mystery solving skills.

results.name: The Boys from Brazil: Rise of the Bolsonaros
results.original_name: The Boys from Brazil: Rise of the Bolsonaros
results.overview: The remarkable rise of one of the world’s most controversial leaders, Jair Bolsonaro, from obscurity to the presidency of Brazil.

known_for.title: The Immortal City
known_for.overview: From the legendary times of Romulus and Remus to the present day, the compelling story of the eternal city's twenty-five centuries of civilization traces the rise of Christianity over paganism through studies of Vatican art treasures.

results.name: Boys from the Blackstuff
results.overview: Alan Bleasdale's five-part series relates the further experiences of unemployed Liverpudlian tarmac layers Dixie, Chrissie, Loggo and Yosser, and their revered older friend, retired longshoreman and union leader, George Malone. As they struggle to make ends meet in a depressed economy, and to hold together their financially battered families, they are harrassed by the petty bureaucrats of the DHSS. But the lumbering investigational juggernaut is, both comically and tragically, guided by drivers with only a provisional license.

results.name: The Lost Boys
results.overview: The story of J.M. Barrie and his relationship with the Llewelyn-Davies family. Barrie writes PETER PAN for the five boys, and later adopts George, Jack, Peter, Michael, and Nicholas.

results.name: The Flaxton Boys
results.overview: The Flaxton Boys is a British historical children's television series produced by Yorkshire Television for ITV, created by Sid Waddell. Four seasons—covering a specific period: 1854, during the Crimean War (series 1), 1890 (series 2), 1928 (series 3), and 1945, in the aftermath of WWII (series 4)—explore four generations of young men and their experiences at Flaxton Hall in Yorkshire.
